items.title: Carter Benny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I did receive help from him... he was certainly a great friend and great inspiration and great . . . he helped me greatly at that time.

ctx.x: One person you did apparently receive some help from was Rosamond Johnson, is that correct?

Well, I must certainly say that I did receive help from him. I wish I’d been able to have spent more time with him, but he was very busy and so was I. But he was in London at the time. Just what he was doing there, I don’t remember. But he was a very, very talented man. Oh, boy, there isn’t enough about him known today or written, you know. But he was certainly a great friend and great inspiration and great . . . he helped me greatly at that time.
